title: Binance Kazakhstan Introduces New Derivatives, Options, and Futures Copy Trading
text: Note: Please do your own research before making any trades for the aforementioned tokens outside Binance to avoid any scams and ensure safety of your funds. This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.   Fellow Binancians,  Binance Kazakhstan  will list new products for  starting  2025-03-13 15:00 (UTC+5) , including Options, Futures Copy Trading, and derivatives. Eligible users can now access these tools on Binance Kazakhstan. Notes: Binance Options : Trade crypto options with limited downside risk. Use  Easy Options Mode  for simplified trading and  Request to Quote  for instant institutional-grade liquidity. BFUSD : A reward-bearing margin asset that serves as futures collateral while earning daily USDT rewards. Futures Copy Trading : Automatically copy experienced traders' portfolios in real time and enhance your trading strategies. Easy Futures :  A simplified one-click order placement mode on the Binance App for seamless trading. For More Details: Options BFUSD Futures Copy Trading Thank you for your support! Binance Kazakhstan Team 2025-03-13
